# P1 / 0.5.53: this file is retained only as documentation of what
# the Semantica Explorer runtime needs. The actual wheel
# (apps/desktop/vendor/semantica-src/builds/semantica-*.whl, mirrored
# to apps/desktop/resources/semantica/builds/ by bundle-cli) bundles
# ALL transitive deps from pyproject.toml [project.dependencies]:
#   - fastapi, uvicorn[standard], pydantic
#   - httpx, requests, aiohttp
#   - numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, networkx
#   - rdflib, spacy, transformers, sentence-transformers, torch
#   - pandas, plotly, matplotlib, seaborn
#   - python-dotenv, pyyaml, loguru, structlog, rich, click
#   - fastembed, faiss-cpu, gensim, umap-learn
#   - gitpython, lxml, beautifulsoup4, pillow, opencv-python, openpyxl,
#     python-docx, librosa, ipywidgets, toml, tqdm, tokenizers
#   - protobuf, grpcio, onnxruntime
#   - chardet
#
# No `pip install` here. run.sh installs the wheel into
# ~/.multica/semantica-venv/ with `pip install --no-index
# --find-links=./builds/ semantica-*.whl`. A future version bump to
# 0.5.5x that drops an upstream dep will simply omit it from the
# new wheel — no edit here.
